entities.name: Klothys
entities.description: The god of fate and destiny on Theros, one of its oldest deities, who guarded the imprisoned titans and has returned to restore the natural order.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane governed by Klothys's fate.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: Another ancient god of Theros, mutually respected by Klothys.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: A god whose ascension disrupted the natural order.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: A god Klothys holds in contempt, who defied the natural order.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God of the Underworld who is consumed by hatred of Heliod and begins to lose control of souls.

entities.name: Athreos
entities.description: God angered by horrors drawn into the mortal world.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker whose soul needs a special agent of Klothys.

entities.name: Calix
entities.description: Klothys's greatest masterpiece, created to deal with Elspeth's soul.

entities.name: Agents of Fate
entities.description: Agents dispatched by Klothys wielding her thread to stop souls reversing their deaths.

entities.name: Titans
entities.description: Sealed in the Underworld by the gods, with Klothys as eternal jailer.

entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: Realm where Klothys long guarded the titans.

entities.name: Andrasteia
entities.description: One of the Fates depicted earlier.

entities.name: Tymna
entities.description: A fate weaver who manipulates threads of fate.

events.summary: Long ago the titans are sealed in the Underworld and Klothys volunteers as their eternal jailer.
events.quote: it was Klothys who volunteered to serve as their eternal jailer.

events.summary: As war breaks out among the gods, Erebos is consumed by hatred of Heliod and begins to lose control of his realm's souls.
events.quote: Erebos was consumed by his hatred of Heliod

events.summary: Klothys, livid at souls reversing their deaths, dispatches Agents of Fate and creates Calix to deal with Elspeth's soul.
events.quote: For this task, Klothys created Calix .

relations.note: Created solely to carry out her will.
relations.quote: For this task, Klothys created Calix .
She shares a deep mutual respect with Kruphix

relations.note: She holds particular contempt for him.
relations.quote: She holds particular contempt for Heliod and his champions
Klothys dispatched numerous Agents of Fate
